# 1 Clement Chapter 29 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 29 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_029_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 29

**29:1** Let us therefore draw near to him with holiness of soul, lifting up pure and undefiled hands to him, loving our gentle and compassionate Father who has made us his chosen portion.

**29:2** For thus it is written: "When the Most High divided the nations, when he scattered the sons of Adam, he fixed the boundaries of the nations according to the number of the angels of God. His people Jacob became the Lord's portion, and Israel the rope of his inheritance."

**29:3** And in another place it says: "Behold, the Lord takes for himself a nation out of the midst of the nations, as a man takes the firstfruits of his threshing floor; and the Holy of Holies shall come forth from that nation."

---

*EMET renders with maximal literalness. Deuteronomy 32:8-9 cited in v. 2; a variant of Deuteronomy 4:34 or a conflation in v. 3. Clement applies the election of Israel typologically to the church as the new chosen portion.*
